purpose: A braced expression in an HSPICE E VOL= form is refused; HSPICE delimits expressions with quotes.

oracle.derivation: Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-19: "Single or double quotes delimit expressions and filenames"; p. 3-21: "Expressions are delimited by single or double quotes"; p. 3-30: braces are allowed in node names and changed to square brackets. HSPICE Quick Reference Guide U-2003.03 (cse.chalmers.se/~perla/ugrad/EDA351/HSPICEQuickRef.pdf), Algebraic Expressions as Input: the general form is 'algebraic expression'. So vol={v(a)*2} is no expression and the card fails.
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
